text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's been some time since Sakura Chiyono
O chose me as her trainer.
On a day off...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer! Hello.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Yep! If I want to compete in the Derby, I
have to work my body
harder than ever!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Maruzen, she's... always been my role model, and now she's entrusted her dream to me. I have to make it come true!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Hehe... Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Well, I'm going to go run some more!
"Three years make a peach,
eight a
persimmon, and infinite belief a Derby
winner!"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The meaning of her saying is lost on me,
but I do get a strong sense of
conviction
coming from her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I need to do more to support her dreams. Or rather, I want to do more. That desire has never been stronger.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After finishing up some work, I stop by the
riverbank again.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Steady, steady... Fight!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Keep going, keep going!

text_block_list.name: Sumo Enthusiast A
text_block_list.text: Hahhh!

text_block_list.name: Sumo Enthusiast B
text_block_list.text: Wh-whoa!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
An underarm throw, beautifully executed!
Well done!

text_block_list.name: Sumo Enthusiast B
text_block_list.text:
Aww! I thought I had a chance when she
stumbled!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Well, you have to watch out for feints. If
your opponent comes low,
be sure to
watch your legs!

text_block_list.name: Sumo Enthusiast B
text_block_list.text: That makes sense... Thanks, Chiyo!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Wait, Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
My dad's a sumo wrestler, you see. So ever
since I was little I've been
going to watch
his matches, and...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: No, no, I'm perfectly fine just watching!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
But those two... and the others in the
neighborhood Umamusume
Sumo
Association, they're serious about sumo.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: A sumo advisor? Me?

text_block_list.name: Sumo Enthusiast A
text_block_list.text:
Even if it's only once! We really want to
get stronger!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Get... stronger...

text_block_list.name: Sumo Enthusiast B
text_block_list.text: I lost again... Being short is just an automatic loss, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
That's not true! Being small means you can
be more nimble. Let's see,
I think my dad
taught me a few moves you could use...

text_block_list.name: Sumo Enthusiast A
text_block_list.text:
Chiyo! I won my practice match! My very
first win!

text_block_list.name: Sumo Enthusiast B
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much! It's all because of your
lessons!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Your hard work is what made the
difference! Congratulations on the
win!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
At first, I only planned on doing it once.
But the more time I spent
with them, the
more I wanted to help.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
They were just so devoted... it gave me
courage, made me want to do
better in my
races.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Huh? Watching me?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
N-no, no, I... I don't deserve that! I'm really
not doing anything out of
the ordinary!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
It's just that being ordinary means I have
to do a lot more than
everyone else and,
yeah...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
But... if me doing that gives you strength,
then I'll work even harder!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
For the dream I share with Maruzen... and
starting from today, for you
too!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeing Chiyono O reaffirm her ambitions, I
feel invigorated yet again.
